Subject: Intro + partner-led discovery for CloudBridge / Redwood

Hi Marissa & Camila,

Great to meet you both on the call earlier — thanks for walking through Redwood's platform capabilities. As discussed, CloudBridge is interested in a technical deep-dive focused on:
- integration points for Cloud Marketplace listings
- auth/KMS flows for private deployments
- expected latency/throughput for multi-tenant marketplace scenarios

Attendees from our side would be myself and our Lead Solutions Architect (I'll confirm name by EOD). For next steps, can we schedule a 60-minute tech deep-dive next week? Our preferred times (PT):
- Tue 24 Feb, 10:00-11:00
- Wed 25 Feb, 13:00-14:00

I've attached a short integrations overview that may help prep.

Thanks,
Sara Khan
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge
Sara.khan@cloudbridge.io | +1 (415) 555-0199

- Goal: validate integration approach for Cloud Marketplace + clarify security/KMS implications for Private deployments.
- Redwood attendees: me (product/partnerships) and Camila (solutions/eng).
- Success criteria for the deep-dive: agreed integration pattern, list of follow-up tech questions, and owner for a sandbox test.

Camila, are you available for either of Sara's proposed slots? If not, please propose two windows next week (PT) that work for engineering.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) 10 min — architecture overview & marketplace model
2) 25 min — integration/auth + KMS discussion (engineering-heavy)
3) 15 min — data residency & SLA/uptime considerations
4) 10 min — next steps / action items

Also attaching Redwood's SOW template (for procurement context) — we can surface this if the conversation moves toward a pilot.

Best,
